subject: math
cluster: Use coordinates to prove simple geometric theorems algebraically

items.prompt:
The distance formula is:
A) $\sqrt{x_2-x_1}+\sqrt{y_2-y_1}$
B) $\sqrt{(x_2-x_1)^2+(y_2-y_1)^2}$
C) $(x_2-x_1)+(y_2-y_1)$
D) $\frac{y_2-y_1}{x_2-x_1}$

steps: It comes from the Pythagorean theorem.
